def fitw(cols_fn, nparam_lin, ws):
    best=None
    for w in ws:
        X=cols_fn(w)
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,w,c.round(4))
    return best
